text:
Sara: quick mid-sprint check — can we do a brief status dump for the console observability milestone? owners + blockers please. I'm tracking dashboards / tracing hooks / error-analysis views / retention. @Elaine @Jordan @TJ pls update.

Mike: dashboards — PR #2426 merged but panels are slow under realistic loads. root cause looks like an expensive join in the error panel. filing PERF-987. :grimacing:

Jordan: tracing hooks — PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/2480. needs sampling config from infra (cc @TJ). added a test for async span flush edge case.

deploy-bot: canary deployed: trace-ingest-canary -> staging (200/200 checks passed initially).

obs-bot: alert during canary: staging trace-ingest returned 503 x3 (ingest:503). logs attached.

TJ: infra update — retention migration INFRA-434 blocked on schema rollout. ETA EOD Thu if no regressions. can try an accelerated toggle but would need DB owner sign-off.

Elaine: dash front — building error-analysis lens (expanded row + sample traces). Need the list of error buckets + sample queries. @Mike can you share the query that's timing out? also design sign-off required for expanded row behavior. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/2491

Mike: query is `SELECT count(*) FROM traces WHERE error = true GROUP BY service` but the problematic piece is the join to events for enrichment. i'll open a simplified view this afternoon.

Jordan: sampling config snippet I'm planning to land with the hook:
```
sampling:
  default: 0.02
  debug_spans: 1.0
```

Sara: owners recap — dashboards = Elaine, traces/hooks = Jordan, retention/infra = TJ, error-analysis + queries = Mike. actions: Elaine to post design checklist by Wed, Jordan to ping for CR by EOD, TJ to update INFRA-434 status in the ticket, Mike to post simplified SQL view. if retention can't land this sprint, move to follow-up sprint. :thumbsup:

Elaine: sgtm, i'll post checklist in docs and tag this thread.

Mike: i'll post the simplified view in ~2h. can we get canary logs link? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: canary-logs -> https://logs.internal/redwood/canary/trace-ingest/3322105555

obs-bot: suggestion: add alert `trace_ingest_503` with 5m window to catch regressions during rollout.

Sara: any CR blockers left? @Jordan @Elaine

Jordan: no blockers from my side; need a perf run that Mike is doing.

Elaine: blocked on a small design question from Product — pinged @Ben for decision.

Sara: thanks all — i'll reconvene Fri sync if anything stays open.
